secondary.note: Special occasions only, not regular company materials (manual p. 22).

color.tints: Every colour may be used at 100, 80, 60, 40 and 20 %. Purple 20 % = #DBD0DD, pink 20 % = #F9D4E7.
color.combination: Primary combination PINK/PURPLE. Small text on colour is white.

font.system: Arial (e-mail, documents opened where Montserrat is missing)

shape.name: základní tvar
shape.description: Panel with the top-right and bottom-left corners cut on the diagonal, echoing the hexagon in the logo. Used flexibly; the logo always sits in the bottom-right corner.
shape.construction: A = shorter side of the format; outer margin A/25, text-frame inset A/15. Valid for 2:3, 3:4, 16:9.

logo.safeZone: built into the logo files as a transparent rectangle
logo.forbidden: No change of shape or colour beyond the manual: no recolouring, rearranging, rotating, italic, outline.

vision.cs: Jsme spolehlivý technologický partner pro digitální evoluci. Otevíráme firmám nové možnosti.
vision.en: We are a trusted technology partner for digital evolution. We connect businesses with new opportunities.

mission.cs: Věříme, že náš software lidem zlepšuje život. Pomáháme firmám i jednotlivcům efektivně využít jejich potenciál k rozvoji.
